fix(text): debounce prewarm and surface preview errors

- Deactivate pending prewarm work when the renderer binding is replaced.
- Debounce prewarm by 150 ms and skip stale revisions so rapid edits do
  not rasterize throwaway frames.
- Report committed-preview optimization failures through the config so
  hosts can stop live timers and show the error.
- Fall back to the main-thread engine if the Worker cannot initialize.
- Reuse hooks configuration from CI instead of committing it.
